description:
Do you use iCloud for your email and calendar? With CERTENTIC Bridge, you can use both together to find information faster. Want to know when you last met someone — and see the emails you exchanged around that meeting?

CERTENTIC Bridge goes further: it can uncover more complex information that would normally take considerable effort to compile. For example, you can ask which recurring orders of a particular product you placed over the last twelve months, what prices you paid, and have relevant PDF attachments in your emails taken into account.

Access is strictly read-only: emails and calendar events are never created, modified, sent, moved, or deleted. Your iCloud credentials are stored encrypted and are used exclusively to access your connected iCloud account. The service infrastructure is hosted in the European Union, and we consistently apply European data protection principles.

CERTENTIC Bridge is operated by CERTENTIC GmbH, a German company, and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Apple Inc.

defaultPrompt: When was my last appointment with John Smith, and which emails have we exchanged since then?
Which appointments did I add today?
Search my emails to find when and where I ordered my Pure Whey over the past twelve months, and how much I paid.
